title: Desert trip with Jake Barber

tellings.quote: when uh Jake took me on a nice little trip out to the desert, that was something that proved to me that this guy was legit.

plain: A man named Michael Herrera, who says he saw a 300-foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle, says a man named Jake Barber once took him on a trip out into the desert. Herrera tells Michels that whatever happened on that trip, which he does not describe, "proved to me that this guy was legit."
